title: Console Release Notes (Draft) — Guided Onboarding Checklist (Beta → GA) — 2026-03
author: Marissa Cole
body:
## Summary
We are introducing a new **Guided Onboarding Checklist** in the Redwood Console to help developers integrating the **Hosted API** reach a reliable first production launch faster. The experience provides a progressive set of steps with deep links to canonical docs and (where feasible) automatic validation based on platform signals.

This release note covers **Beta** (feature-flagged) and **GA** readiness expectations.

---

## What’s new
### 1) In-product guided checklist (Console)
A new checklist experience appears in Console for eligible orgs/projects and guides users through:
- Creating an API key (and distinguishing **test vs prod** key usage)
- Making a first successful request
- Trying streaming responses
- Reviewing usage analytics / dashboards
- Understanding rate limits and quotas and how to handle 429s
- Preparing for a “first production launch” (minimum safeguards and rollback guidance)

Checklist steps include:
- **Step status** (Not started / In progress / Completed)
- **Deep links to docs** (version-stable URLs + UTM tagging)
- **Inline guidance** for common issues (e.g., 401/429/timeout/stream disconnect)

### 2) Validation signals (automatic completion where possible)
The checklist can automatically mark certain steps complete using platform signals (example set; exact behavior varies by cohort and project configuration):
- First successful Hosted API request detected for a project
- First streaming session detected
- Usage dashboard visit detected
- API key created and labeled (test/prod)

### 3) Onboarding telemetry (event schema v1)
We are instrumenting onboarding progress with a stable event schema to measure:
- Completion funnel (step-by-step)
- Drop-off points
- Time-to-first-success and time-to-first-production-launch

Telemetry is subject to the privacy constraints described below (no prompt content collection, property allowlists, and retention tags).

---

## Availability & rollout
### Beta (feature-flagged)
- **Audience:** Subset of new signups + allowlisted orgs.
- **Enablement:** Controlled via Console feature flag + cohort targeting.
- **Support tooling:** Internal admin override to reset checklist state for troubleshooting is available for beta orgs.

### GA (planned)
GA will expand cohort exposure and set the checklist on by default for eligible Hosted API self-serve orgs after meeting:
- Telemetry pipeline health SLOs (no sustained missing/late events)
- Docs parity across SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) for required onboarding snippets
- UX quality bar (accessibility, copy consistency, stable deep links)
- Support enablement (macros + troubleshooting page published)

---

## Known limitations (Beta)
1) **Hosted API only (Phase 1):**
   - The checklist does not cover Dedicated or Private deployment onboarding.

2) **Validation is not instantaneous:**
   - Some step completion signals can lag due to ingestion/aggregation windows.
   - Users may need to refresh Console to see updated status.

3) **Automatic validation coverage is partial:**
   - Not all production-readiness items are automatically validated.
   - Several items remain “guided/manual” (e.g., verifying your own alerting/rollback runbooks).

4) **Multi-project behavior:**
   - Completion is tracked per project; users with multiple projects may see different step states.
   - Some org-level steps (e.g., key creation) are reflected across projects, but completion logic is still evolving.

5) **Docs deep links are version-stable, but not fully localized:**
   - Links target canonical docs pages; localized variants (where applicable) may not be available.

6) **Telemetry privacy constraints may limit segmentation:**
   - Onboarding telemetry does **not** collect customer prompt content.
   - Properties are restricted to an allowlist; some desired breakdowns may not be available until schema v1.1+.

---

## Customer-facing docs to reference
Use the following canonical docs pages when communicating this feature:
- First production launch (Hosted API): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/first-production-launch
- Quickstart (Hosted API): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/quickstarts/hosted-api
- Streaming: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/streaming
- Retries, timeouts, and error handling: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/retries-and-timeouts
- Rate limits & quotas (429 guidance): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/rate-limits-and-quotas
- Troubleshooting onboarding issues (401/429/timeout/stream disconnect/CORS): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/support/troubleshooting/onboarding

Note: Console deep links append UTM tags (source=console, medium=onboarding_checklist, campaign=guided_onboarding_2026_03) for attribution.

---

## Support notes (internal)
- For beta orgs reporting “step not completing,” confirm:
  1) Feature flag eligibility
  2) Project context (correct project selected)
  3) Expected validation lag window
  4) If needed, use admin reset workflow per: confluence://eng-platform/runbooks/console-checklist-feature-flag-rollout

- Common failure patterns addressed by the checklist:
  - 401 due to wrong environment key (test vs prod)
  - 429 due to quota/rate limits without backoff
  - Streaming disconnects due to network/proxy timeouts

---

## Metrics to watch (internal)
- Median time: signup → first successful API response
- Median time: signup → first production launch completion
- Step completion funnel and drop-off rate
- Correlation with week-1 retention / repeat usage
- Telemetry health: missing event rate, ingestion delay, regional gaps

---

## Open items before GA
- Finalize and publish GA launch criteria checklist (internal)
- Confirm E2E test coverage for step progression across sessions
- Validate telemetry alerts for missing onboarding events
- Confirm support macros reference the new troubleshooting page and checklist UI terminology (org vs project, test vs prod key)

---

## Change log (draft)
- 2026-03-04: Initial draft created for beta release train.
- 2026-03-12: Added known limitations for validation lag and multi-project behavior; aligned doc URLs with docs IA update.
- 2026-03-18: Added privacy/telemetry constraints summary and GA readiness bullets.
